summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting  ### What I found before proposing anything (read-only audit, no changes made)  I traced the full chain: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` → `watchlists`/`watchlist_items` tables, plus `useAuth.tsx`/`App.tsx` for the login gate.  Contrary to the ticket's hypothesis, I could **not** find the specific bug it names (no local/anonymous storage fallback, no missing session check, no hardcoded/default watchlist_id): - `WatchlistPage.tsx` has zero localStorage/sessionStorage us
